verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the CLI docs, which say users can 'explore the API interactively — discover endpoints, preview requests, and inspect schemas.' The CLI defaults to sandbox, so commands can run safely against test resources. This is an interactive, runnable API exploration path, but it is terminal-based rather than a documented interactive API reference. Missing for 10: a documented web API reference with in-page 'try it' runnable examples, per-endpoint runnable code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
